_comment: shape: single (target point), line (3 tiles ahead), cone (3 wide, 2.5 deep), ring (radius 2 around the user), self. vfx family: burst | projectile | beam | ring | cloud, tinted by the move's type colour and scaled by size. anim: the SpriteCollab action the attacker plays. strip (optional): a hand-made sprite strip under assets/vfx/ that replaces the procedural family. cooldown and cast in seconds. recoil (optional): the user takes that share of the damage it dealt, once per use. contact (optional): overrides whether a physical one-target move lunges in (dashes like Quick Attack do; Stone Edge's spikes don't). Cooldowns, animations, recoil, origins and the new ladder moves come from scripts/move_balance.py (rerun it after editing a move's power, shape or effects). dash (optional): a priority dash lunges that much faster and further. knock (optional): how hard a contact hit or a slam's landing shoves, times the usual. A contact move or slam lands only on a body its user is touching when it strikes (data.ts contactReach); shots and blasts stop at walls (match.ts shotClear). Effect and dash/knock changes since 28 October: scripts/move_audit.py. drain (optional): the user gets back that share of the HP the hit took. reach (optional): a contact move that strikes from that many tiles past its user's body (Vine Whip).
_fx: fx: Guardian Signs effects (assets/fx/guardian_signs/<id>.png) played when the move resolves. anchor: attacker (on the user; mode beam tiles the strip from user to target, stream stretches it), projectile (flies user -> target; the target parts after it play on arrival; arc lobs it), sky (falls onto each target from `height` tiles up), target (on each Pokemon hit, at the middle of its body, scaled gently with its size). mode status loops above the head. ground: drawn flat under the Pokemon (rings, puddles, cracks). delay: seconds before the part starts. fps default 15, scale default 2 (pixels per source pixel at the normal zoom), tint optional. shake: screen shake on heavy hits (0..1). One idea per move: a wind-up or carrier, one impact, at most one aftershock. origin (projectiles, beams and streams): where it leaves the user, read from the sprite's Offsets sheet for the frame shown: mouth (default: the head point), hands, or body.
